properties.description: Successful Entra app-role assignment or delegated permission grant audit whose ServicePrincipal target ID matches an enabled agent inventory identity; a configuration review signal, not an escalation claim.
properties.displayName: AI Agent | Permission assignment audit targets a registered agent identity
properties.query:
// TargetResources establishes identity targeting, not the grantee role or permission risk.
let Agents = _GetWatchlist('AIAgentInventory')
    | where tolower(tostring(Enabled)) == 'true'
    | project AgentId = tolower(tostring(AgentId)), AgentSP = tolower(tostring(ServicePrincipalObjectId))
    | where isnotempty(AgentId) and isnotempty(AgentSP)
    | distinct AgentId, AgentSP;
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h) and Result =~ 'success'
| where OperationName in~ ('Add app role assignment to service principal', 'Add delegated permission grant')
| where isnotempty(Id)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Id
| mv-expand Target = TargetResources
| extend AgentSP = tolower(tostring(Target.id)), ActorUPN = tolower(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName))
| where tostring(Target.type) =~ 'ServicePrincipal' and isnotempty(AgentSP)
| join kind=inner Agents on AgentSP
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Id, AgentId, AgentSP
| project TimeGenerated, AgentId, ActorUPN, ServicePrincipalObjectId = AgentSP,
          Evidence = tostring(bag_pack('auditId', Id, 'operation', OperationName, 'targetId', AgentSP, 'targetRole', 'Unresolved; inspect audit payload', 'assessment', 'Permission configuration audit; risk not established')),
          CorrelationQuality = 'configuration', AccountCustomEntity = ActorUPN
